name: Security Goon

reactions.name: Get Back!
reactions.description:
A creature adjacent to the goon is targeted by an attack

Effect The goon jumps in the way of the attack, changing places with the original target, and becoming the attack's new target.

actions.name: License to Break Bones
actions.description:
Requirements A creature within the goon's reach is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}

Effect The goon assaults the prone creature with a flurry of stomps. The creature must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:16] saving throw.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes @Damage[1d4[bludgeoning]] damage.

Failure The creature takes @Damage[2d4[bludgeoning]] damage and is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF]{Suppressed} until it starts its turn without being prone.

Critical Failure As failure, but the creature takes double damage.

notes: Every number here is a direct transcription of the real bestiary statblock (gamesystems/sf2e/packs/rulebook-bestiaries) — NPCs store final, precomputed combat numbers, so no derivation was needed. See test/character-builder/extract-npc.test.mjs and design/scale-and-chassis.md §19. "License to Break Bones" (a Fortitude-save, Prone-requiring action) is captured under `actions` for transcript honesty but is NOT a usable strike — this engine has no saving-throw mechanism.
